sectionDescription: Sovereign Identity & Access for the AI Era

features.title: Login & SSO
features.description: Email/password, OAuth providers, and cross-domain single sign-on across 60+ Heady domains via relay iframe.

features.title: API Key Management
features.description: Issue, list, and revoke API keys (hdy_ prefix, SHA-256 hashed). Supports service-to-service verification.

features.title: RBAC & Zero-Trust
features.description: Role-based access control (guest, user, operator, admin) with explicit CORS, no wildcards, and mTLS between services.

features.title: Audit & Compliance
features.description: Every auth event logged with SHA-256 action hashes. SOC 2 gap remediation in progress. Ed25519 Merkle audit trail via HeadyGuard.
